messages:
priya-finance: FYI: BRASSHOOK invoice INV-2026-0214 for $72,400 is 45 days past due. Customer claims they never received the PDF. I'm recommending we reissue and hold off final dunning for 48h while CS confirms contact details. tagging @sarah-cs @mike-sales

sarah-cs: Reached out to their finance lead (julia@brasshook.com). She says the vendor portal email went to spam. Asked that we reissue the invoice and provide a payment schedule PDF they can attach to their PO. They proposed a 3-month installment plan (May/June/July). cc @mike-sales

mike-sales: Confirmed on my side. Contract allows split payments for legacy accounts with good payment history. I can get leadership sign-off for a 3-month split as long as we don't put them on hold and usage continues.

priya-finance: Agree — avoid service interruption if possible. Proposed terms: 3 equal installments of $24,133.34 due 2026-05-01, 2026-06-01, 2026-07-01. Waive late fee if first installment is paid by 2026-05-10 and amendment signed by 2026-05-05. I'll draft the amendment and the one-page schedule. Assigning to @billing-bot to reissue the invoice with clear instructions and net dates.

billing-bot: Auto: Reissued INV-2026-0214 -> INV-2026-0214R; PDF emailed to julia@brasshook.com and finance@brasshook.com. Link: https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/INV-2026-0214R :mailbox_with_mail:

sarah-cs: Julia just replied — she has the reissued PDF and will route to AP today. She asked for the one-page payment schedule (they need it for their PO). Can finance add that to the email?

priya-finance: Will do. I'll attach a payment schedule PDF and a short amendment SOW for signature. Note for records: because this crosses fiscal quarters we need ARR/recognition notes in the ledger. @alex-ops can you flag the account so ops/metrics aren't impacted?

alex-ops: Logged internal flag 'pending-settlement' on account brasshook-123; service NOT interrupted. Added internal note with the installment schedule and due dates. Set collection-stage = 'offer-made'.

mike-sales: Thanks. I'll send the amendment to Julia for signature now. Also confirming — finance is comfortable waiving interest per Priya's terms?

priya-finance: Waive interest for this one-off if amendment is signed by 2026-05-05 AND first payment posts by 2026-05-10. If either condition fails, standard 1.5% monthly interest applies and we resume regular dunning. If a payment misses, we escalate to collections. Please keep me updated on signatures and payment receipts.

sarah-cs: Julia just signed and returned the amendment (screenshot attached). She says AP will run the first payment through within 48h.

mike-sales: Signed copy confirmed. Julia signed at 2026-04-28 16:12 PDT. Requesting finance to send the secure payment link for the first installment.

priya-finance: Payment link sent via billing portal just now. I've scheduled reminders 3 days before each due date and set internal reminders for follow-up. Billing bot will post receipts when payments process.

billing-bot: Auto: Payment link sent to julia@brasshook.com for INV-2026-0214R. Webpay URL: https://billing.redwood.example/pay/INV-2026-0214R/token-xxxxx

sarah-cs: Julia confirms payment is in process. Everything looks good from CS. Closing the escalation chain unless finance wants to keep this open for tracking. :partyparrot:
